curated_items.summary: NVIDIA RTX Spark powers thin and light laptops built for everything that developers, creators and gamers do. RTX Spark laptops are now available from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI. These powerful systems combine an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and an NVIDIA Grace CPU in a single superchip with up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance. That puts the NVIDIA CUDA platform, RTX graphics and the capabilities of a personal AI supercomputer inside premium Windows laptops built to go anywhere. New and expected RTX Spark updates, coming soon, include: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open weight speech model for transcription, speaker attribution and translation is available on RTX Spark.
